Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly identify the poem in question. In step 4, the agent visited the Wikisource page titled "Father, Son and Holy Ghost," but this page contains a hymn by Charles Wesley, not Audre Lorde's poem. The agent incorrectly assumed this was the correct source for the requested poem and proceeded to analyze it (implicitly or explicitly in the planning process) as if it were the target text. This led to the analysis of the wrong poem entirely, preventing the solution to the actual problem regarding Audre Lorde's work. The agent should have recognized that the title match was superficial (same title, different author/content) and continued searching or switched strategies earlier.
